PLI_Scheme_Official_Name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing
Cabinet_Approval_Date: Gazette/MeitY state 2020-03-20; corresponding PIB release carries posting date 2020-03-21 (likely a next-day posting - cite the 20.03.2020 gazette date and note the PIB posting date; do not present as a factual conflict)
Alternative_Dates_for_R1: 2020-03-20 (Cabinet per gazette); 2020-04-01 (notification); 2021-08-01 (elected Year 1 under 23.09.2021 amendment); 2020-08 +/- 3 months
Covered_Products_Scheme_Wording: Para 4: 'The Scheme shall only be applicable for target segments namely mobile phones and specified electronic components (as detailed in Annexure B).' Eligibility annexure splits into 'Mobile Phones (Invoice value of INR 15000 and above)' and 'Mobile Phones (Domestic Companies)'.
Proposed_HS_Basis: 851712 (through Mar-2022) + 851713 + 851714 (from Apr-2022), summed across vintages. HS-4 8517 total as continuity robustness.
HS_Verification_Status: TO VERIFY - see Phase 2 Step 2. HS2022 believed to split 8517.12 into 8517.13 (smartphones) and 8517.14 (other telephones for cellular networks). HIGH confidence but NOT verified against India ITC(HS)-2022 schedule.
Mapping_Confidence: HIGH (scheme names the product; HS lines specific) - pending HS verification
Notes_and_Vulnerabilities: Para 10.5 of the ORIGINAL 1 Apr 2020 gazette states 'Incentives under the Scheme will be applicable from 01.08.2020' - this was NOT introduced by a later amendment. The 23.09.2021 amendment lets approved companies ELECT any 5 consecutive years FY2020-21 to FY2025-26; it is an applicant election, not a blanket shift of Year 1. VULNERABILITIES: only 28 pre-months. COVID ASYMMETRY - the Apr-Jun 2020 collapse falls in the pre-period and the Jul 2020 to Mar 2021 rebound falls in the post-period; without a Covid control this depresses beta1 and steepens the post segment, both pushing beta3 UPWARD, and the block Covid dummy absorbs the collapse but NOT the rebound, so a residual upward bias survives the baseline specification. The sign of the bias in delta-sigma is AMBIGUOUS, since the rebound inflates sigma_post as well as sigma_pre. Also: exports include re-exports; high import content means gross export value overstates domestic value added.

Notes_and_Vulnerabilities: CRITICAL FRAMING: the bulk-drugs PLI is greenfield-only and its STATED purpose is reducing API IMPORT DEPENDENCE, not raising exports. A null beta3 is the EXPECTED result and should be framed as consistent with scheme design, not as a failed test. DO NOT use the QE group 'Drugs & Pharmaceuticals' - it is dominated by FORMULATIONS, the opposite end of the value chain from the APIs/KSMs the bulk-drugs PLI targets. This is exactly the misclassification in the existing project. ADVANTAGE: Ds = Apr 2022 gives a balanced 48/48 pre/post split - the strongest statistical case in the sector set.

PLI_Scheme_Official_Name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights) Manufacturers in India
First_Incentive_Period_Start: FY2022-23 (first year of incremental sale per notification para 4.2)
Covered_Products_Scheme_Wording: Para 3.1 Air conditioners: (i) Air Conditioners (Components - High value Intermediates or Low Value Intermediates or sub-assemblies or a combination thereof); (ii) High Value Intermediates (Copper Tubes, Aluminium Foil and Compressors); (iii) Low Value Intermediates (PCB assembly for controllers, BLDC motors, Service Valves and Cross Flow fans for AC and other components). Para 8.1: 'Mere assembly of finished goods shall not be incentivized.'
HS_Verification_Status: Stable across HS2017/HS2022 at HS-4 - TO CONFIRM empirically in Phase 2 Step 2.
Notes_and_Vulnerabilities: VULNERABILITY TO DECLARE UP FRONT: the scheme targets COMPONENTS and explicitly excludes mere assembly, while HS 8415 is dominated by FINISHED units. The mapping is therefore imperfect by construction. Base year is FY2019-20, NOT FY2020-21 - the 16.08.2021 corrigendum only permits pre-qualified applicants to use the HIGHER of FY2019-20/FY2020-21 as the sales comparator. Note para 4.2 verbatim: 'The first year of investment will be FY 2021-22 and the first year of incremental sale will be FY 2022-23.' ADVANTAGE: very strong seasonal signal - a good demonstration that the month-FE seasonality handling works. Balanced 48/48 split.

Alternative_Dates_for_R1: Placebo dates matched to each treated sector's Ds
Proposed_HS_Basis: TO BE DECIDED IN PHASE 2 STEP 1
Notes_and_Vulnerabilities: MUST BE PRE-COMMITTED IN WRITING WITH JUSTIFICATION BEFORE ANY ESTIMATION. This is the most persuasive robustness check in the design (R3) and the primary answer to 'how do you know this isn't the post-COVID recovery?'. Selecting it after seeing results would invalidate it. SELECTION CRITERIA: comparable global-demand exposure AND a comparable secular growth regime (the real analogue of parallel trends). CANDIDATES: leather goods, ceramic products, marine products, gems & jewellery. CAVEATS ON CANDIDATES - gems & jewellery is dominated by re-export routing (India imports rough, exports polished), which is the same structural problem flagged as vulnerability V7 for the treated series, and it took an idiosyncratic hit from 2022 Russian rough-diamond sanctions; marine products carry US antidumping and shrimp-specific shocks. None of the candidates has a fast-scaling growth regime comparable to assembly electronics - this mismatch must be stated as a limitation whichever is chosen.
